footnote: Figures approximate, from public quote pages as of the Oct 9, 2026 close. Refreshed weekly (Mondays). Always confirm current prices/valuations independently.

kpis.sub: ILLUMINA (ILMN) EXTENDS ITS RUN TO $278 AS THE STREET SPLITS WIDELY ON THE TARGET
kpis.label: ILMN closed at $278.17 on Oct 9 (+5.1% on the day), at roughly 52x trailing earnings. The 21-analyst average target is $233.55 (about 16% below price) but targets span $168 (BofA, Underperform) to $310 (RBC, Outperform) after a wave of raises. Q3 results are due Oct 29.

kpis.sub: TEMPUS AI (TEM) NOW NEAR ITS $72.72 TARGET; MODERNA/MERCK COLLABORATION EXPANDED OCT 7
kpis.label: TEM closed at $70.93 on Oct 9 (down from $76.63 a week earlier), roughly 2.5% below the $72.72 consensus target. TTM revenue is $1.43B (+50%) with a net loss near $254M. The expanded Moderna/Merck cancer-vaccine collaboration and 13 ESMO abstracts are the week's operating news; the Personalis deal and Guardant litigation remain open.

kpis.sub: RECURSION (RXRX) +10% ON OCT 9 TO $4.36; AVERAGE TARGET $7.22
kpis.label: RXRX rose 10.4% on Oct 9 to $4.36 (market cap $2.34B); the 7-analyst average target is $7.22. No new company-specific release since the Sept 20 Tempus licence extension; next earnings estimated Nov 4. Prior short-interest data (about 33%) was not re-verified this week.

kpis.sub: ARKG AUM FALLS TO $2.05B FROM $2.17B; TOP-10 CONCENTRATION 58.30%
kpis.label: ARKG closed at $51.30 on Oct 9 (+4.1% on the day) with 34 holdings, a 0.75% expense ratio, a trailing 1-year return of about 59.7% (down from about 87% a week earlier) and about 8.8% a year since its Oct 31, 2014 inception. Top weights: 10x Genomics 9.23%, Twist 8.55%, Tempus 8.30%.

themes.tag: THE SEQUENCING LEADER RALLIES INTO EARNINGS WITH THE STREET DIVIDED
themes.title: Illumina at $278 sits above the $233.55 average target; analysts range from $168 to $310 ahead of Oct 29
themes.description: ILMN gained 5.1% on Oct 9 and has been up roughly 110% YTD. RBC ($310), Guggenheim ($305), Piper ($305) and Leerink ($300) raised targets while BofA ($168, Underperform) and Barclays ($200, Underweight) remain below price. Illumina also released SpliceAI2, an AI splicing-variant model for rare disease. The turnaround is real; the debate is how much is priced in before the Q3 print.

themes.title: Tempus AI slips to $70.93 and expands its Moderna/Merck vaccine collaboration
themes.description: TEM fell about 7% over the week to $70.93, now close to the $72.72 consensus target. Operating news: expanded multi-year Moderna/Merck cancer-vaccine collaboration (Oct 7), 13 ESMO abstracts (Oct 1), and an FDA 510(k) for an ECG-based mitral regurgitation flag (Sep 28). TTM revenue is $1.43B (+50%) against a net loss near $254M; the Personalis deal and Guardant litigation are not resolved in this week's coverage.

themes.tag: IN-VIVO EDITING: CARDIOVASCULAR DATA ARRIVES WHILE THE FIRST FILING AWAITS A DECISION
themes.title: CRISPR Therapeutics presents CTX310 Phase 1b data at AHA; Intellia's lonvo-z carries a March 10, 2027 PDUFA date
themes.description: CRISPR Therapeutics announced late-breaking Phase 1b CTX310 (ANGPTL3) data at the AHA Scientific Sessions on Oct 8 and closed at $53.39 (+5.9% Oct 9). Intellia's lonvo-z BLA for hereditary angioedema was accepted Sept 8 with Priority Review and a Mar 10, 2027 PDUFA date, and the company added a debt facility of up to $400M from OrbiMed. Acceptance is not approval.

themes.tag: ARKG SHRINKS AS THE TRAILING-YEAR GAIN FADES
themes.title: ARKG AUM drops to $2.05B and its trailing-year return narrows to about 60% from about 87%

Specific ARK trades for this week could not be confirmed from the sources reached, so none are reported here. The 12-year record is the honest context for any single strong year.

private_watchlist.name: Insilico Medicine
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update found this week. Still the only name in this group already public (HKEX, Dec 2025, $292M IPO).

The company continues hiring out its business-development function to line up partnerships that supply preclinical disease-area data rather than capital — it says the $1.3B already raised covers its near-term needs — but no partner has been named and no trial has started.

private_watchlist.name: NewLimit
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update found this week. Still the year's largest single disclosed longevity round (~71% of 2026's disclosed longevity funding through August); its first candidate medicine remains in large-scale manufacturing with clinical entry targeted as early as 2027.

bear_case.title: Biology still fails in the clinic — and the clock hasn't moved
bear_case.description: Zero AI-discovered drugs have reached full FDA approval out of 200+ in clinical development. Insilico's lead investigator puts rentosertib's realistic approval at 2029-2030. Intellia's BLA (PDUFA Mar 10, 2027) is gene editing, not AI discovery — the first approvals look likelier to be modalities than platforms.

bear_case.title: Illumina and platform names price ahead of consensus
bear_case.description: ILMN ($278.17) is about 16% above its $233.55 average target with BofA ($168) and Barclays ($200) well below price; SDGR ($27.28) is about 27% above its $21.43 target. Q3 prints on Oct 29 (ILMN, LLY) are the next test.

bear_case.title: Diagnostics litigation and M&A integration remain unresolved
bear_case.description: Guardant is appealing the federal judgment (announced Aug 24) and the Tempus dispute is open; Tempus is funding Personalis with stock while still loss-making (net loss ~$254M TTM).

bear_case.title: Sub-scale proteomics and crowded names
bear_case.description: Quantum-Si (QSI) jumped 25% to $1.53 on Oct 9 after reporting 19 amino acids detected on Proteus, but TTM revenue is $1.61M (-53%), 2025 net loss ~$101M, and commercial launch is not until Q2 2027. Eikon (-58% vs IPO) and Generate (below IPO) show how IPO-window names can fade.
